name: spritecook
description: Generate sprites, build matching UI kits, upload reference images, and animate game art with SpriteCook.

interface.longDescription: Create sprites, tilesets, animations, and matching UI kits for your game in ChatGPT and Codex. Use reference images and saved presets to keep assets consistent, work with your SpriteCook asset library, and prepare character assets for Godot. Connect a SpriteCook account to get started. Available tools depend on your account, and generation can take a few minutes.
defaultPrompt: Generate a tiny pixel art knight character, idle pose.
Design a matching inventory screen, extract its reusable UI components, and finalize the UI kit.
Animate this existing sprite into a short idle loop.
